item.title: Mie Food Guide: Matsusaka Beef, Ise Lobster & Pearl Bay Seafood
item.description: Mie is one of Japan’s most rewarding food destinations. It lies at the intersection of two food cultures that rarely overlap: a premium beef tradition of the highest calibre, centred on the inland city of Matsusaka, and a Pacific coastal seafood tradition that draws on the exceptionally clean waters of Ago Bay and the Kumano Coast. The two rarely appear on the same table, and that is part of the pleasure of visiting — each meal in Mie feels like an argument for an entirely different region of Japan.
